metadata.description: Azure region for all dashboard resources.

Globally unique lowercase Function App name and job prefix, starting with a letter and without consecutive hyphens. At most 19 characters keeps the derived -db-provision job within the Container Apps 32-character limit.

Default endpoint access. Enabled (default) serves the dashboard over public HTTPS behind GitHub OAuth sign-in; no VPN, proxy, or corporate-network rule is required. Set Disabled only for a deliberately private deployment.

Default action for unmatched main-site requests. Allow (default) is the public-main model: GitHub OAuth remains the access control. Use Deny with explicit rules only for a deliberately restricted deployment. Never changes SCM restrictions.

Reviewed main-site access restriction rules. Explicitly carry forward existing approved rules during redeployment; omission uses an empty list. Unmatched requests use functionAccessRestrictionsDefaultAction.
Reviewed SCM/Kudu access restriction rules, separate from main-site rules. Explicitly carry forward existing approved SCM rules; omission uses an empty list.
Whether SCM reuses main-site rules. Carry forward the existing approved setting; false keeps SCM independently restricted by default.
Azure App Service plan name for the Function App.
Application Insights component name.
Optional reviewed HTTPS OTLP/HTTP collector base URL, without credentials, query or fragment. Empty disables Go export; Application Insights settings alone only configure the Functions host.
Explicit opt-in to export bounded operational Go logs to the OTLP collector. Independent audit delivery is unchanged.
Optional OTLP authentication headers from a secret manager. Stored only in Key Vault; never supply literal values in command-line arguments or checked-in parameters.
Globally unique storage account name for Azure Functions runtime state.
Globally unique Azure Container Registry name containing the Function App image.
Container repository containing cao-dashboard azure-functions. The existing cao-functions image repository remains supported.
Immutable or reviewed tag of the CAO Azure Functions runtime image.
Exact Functions image digest, including sha256:. When supplied, takes precedence over the tag. Does not establish scan or production assurance.
Key Vault name used for GitHub OAuth, session, PostgreSQL, and collection secrets.
Enable purge protection for production vaults. Disable only for explicitly disposable environments that must be purged after testing. Existing protected vaults cannot be downgraded.
Globally unique name for a new private PostgreSQL Flexible Server.
PostgreSQL administrator password. Use secret-manager input; never commit it.
Optional existing network security group kept attached to every private subnet. Supply it when an approved NSG is already attached so redeployment does not detach it.

PostgreSQL database that holds the canonical and operational stores. The default matches existing deployments. A new name creates a new, empty database; the previous database is retained, not deleted.
Runtime-only PostgreSQL URL secret. Use a new name and database when moving from the administrator-backed topology.
Separately generated bootstrap-login password from the operator secret manager. Never reuse the administrator or runtime password.
Separately generated runtime-login password from the operator secret manager.
ACR repository containing the azure-db-provision Dockerfile target.
Exact database-provisioning image digest, including sha256:. When supplied, takes precedence over the tag.
Repository of an explicitly built snapshot or empty ingestion image in this deployment registry.
Exact ingestion image digest, including sha256:. When supplied, takes precedence over the tag.
Maximum bytes retained in the disposable operational cache.
Maximum size of one disposable operational cache value.
Maximum number of disposable operational cache entries.
Maximum bytes retained in protected operational records.
Maximum number of protected operational records.

Run and linked history retention in days. Before starting any role, explicitly preserve at least the greatest existing effective retention across all roles and the snapshot window. The 45-day default is not an upgrade recommendation.
Public host names that Azure Front Door/App Service is allowed to forward to the Go dashboard handler.
GitHub organizations whose active members are authorized.
GitHub teams whose active members are authorized, expressed as org/team-slug.
GitHub user logins authorized directly, without organization membership lookup.
GitHub OAuth App client ID. Do not use a PAT; the server only supports the OAuth authorization-code flow.
GitHub OAuth App client secret. It is written only to Key Vault and consumed by the Function App through a Key Vault reference.
At least 32 characters of random session secret material used to encrypt server-side OAuth sessions.
Optional previous session secret retained during controlled key rotation until active sessions and pending revocations are drained.
Single Log Analytics workspace shared by every role in this deployment.
Optional container image running the collection role. Empty deploys no collection.
GitHub App identifier whose installations define ingestion scope. Required with collectorImage.
GitHub App private key in PEM form. Required with collectorImage.
Shared secret verifying GitHub webhook deliveries. Required with collectorImage.
GitHub logins permitted to run administrative operations.
Control repository used for logical source discovery, in OWNER/REPOSITORY form.
Fixed number of PostgreSQL-backed collection workers.
Evidence lake file share tier. Premium is provisioned SSD; Standard is IOPS-throttled by share size.
Provision an optional paid ADX destination only. Does not enable export, traces, or mining; Azure Functions is not a supported exporter host.
Globally unique ADX cluster name: lowercase letters and digits only.
ADX database identifier: ASCII letter followed by letters, digits, or underscores.
Reviewed paid ADX SKU. The default is development-only without an SLA, not the free offering.
Reviewed ADX instance count compatible with the selected SKU and tier.
